comparison.objective: Clip a wafer to an e-beam sample plate and load it face-down through a safely operated load lock.
comparison.physical_skill: Select clips, center a wafer, repeatedly regrasp and turn a screwdriver, flip a coupled assembly, and operate a door lock.
comparison.success_condition: Each screw turns 300–420 degrees, wafer remains intact and face-down, loading occurs on green, and the door is open under 120 seconds before being shut and locked.
comparison.reason: Despite precise tool use and force-sensitive damage avoidance, it tests threaded fastening and load-lock sequencing rather than impact fracture and collection of released pieces.
